```{r lmm test}
library(nlme)
library(ape)

ROOT <- "/lustre/scratch125/casm/teams/team267/users/yw2/colon"
database = read.csv(file.path(ROOT, "metadata/fap_database_withexposure.csv"), header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA'))
rownames(database) = database$sample
database$num_APC = 3 - (is.na(database$germlinehit) + is.na(database$somatic1) + is.na(database$somatic2))
drivers = read.csv(file.path(ROOT, "metadata/somatic_drivers.csv"), header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# somatic_drivers.csv now also carries FAP targeted-panel (TGS) and
# whole-exome (WES) crypts, which have different gene coverage and sensitivity
# and no phylogeny. This analysis is WGS-only, so drop them.
if ("Source" %in% names(drivers)) {
  n_before = nrow(drivers)
  drivers = drivers[drivers$Source == "WGS", , drop = FALSE]
  message("somatic_drivers.csv: kept ", nrow(drivers), " WGS rows, dropped ",
          n_before - nrow(drivers), " TGS/WES rows")
}
PATIENTS = c("PD40734", "PD42778", "PD44720", "PD44721", "PD45542")

coarse_type = function(type) {
  if (type %in% c("diminutive_polyp", "large_polyp")) return("polyp")
  if (type %in% c("monocryptal_adenoma", "oligocryptal_adenoma")) return("adenoma")
  if (type == "bc") return("bc")
  if (type == "aca") return("aca")
  return(NA_character_)
}

lineage_trunk = function(lineage_tips, tree) {
  node = tryCatch(getMRCA(tree, lineage_tips), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(node) || is.na(node)) return(NULL)
  clade_tips = extract.clade(tree, node)$tip.label
  list(node = node, clade = clade_tips)
}

fit_path = function(patient, node) paste0(ROOT, "/HDP/snv/refit/fit_branch_", patient, "_", node, ".txt")

# consecutive branches below the individual-refit threshold accumulate into
# burden_adj until a branch that has its own refit is reached (the
# anchor)
climb_and_allocate = function(start_node, stop_node, tree_df, patient) {
  tree_df$parent[tree_df$node == stop_node] = stop_node

  total_adj = 0; total_sbs1 = 0; total_sbs5 = 0; unassigned = 0; any_assigned = FALSE
  current_branch = start_node
  parent_branch = tree_df$parent[tree_df$node == current_branch]
  burden_adj = 0
  while (current_branch != parent_branch) {
    while (!file.exists(fit_path(patient, current_branch))) {
      if (current_branch == parent_branch) break
      v = tree_df$adj_x[tree_df$node == current_branch]
      if (!is.na(v)) burden_adj = burden_adj + v
      current_branch = parent_branch
      parent_branch = tree_df$parent[tree_df$node == current_branch]
    }
    anchor_branch = current_branch
    burden_adj = burden_adj + tree_df$adj_x[tree_df$node == current_branch]
    while (!file.exists(fit_path(patient, parent_branch))) {
      if (current_branch == parent_branch) break
      v = tree_df$adj_x[tree_df$node == parent_branch]
      if (!is.na(v)) burden_adj = burden_adj + v
      current_branch = parent_branch
      parent_branch = tree_df$parent[tree_df$node == current_branch]
    }
    if (file.exists(fit_path(patient, anchor_branch))) {
      sig_df = read.table(fit_path(patient, anchor_branch))
      total_sbs1 = total_sbs1 + sig_df["SBS1", 1] * burden_adj
      total_sbs5 = total_sbs5 + sig_df["SBS5", 1] * burden_adj
      any_assigned = TRUE
    } else {
      unassigned = unassigned + burden_adj
    }
    total_adj = total_adj + burden_adj
    current_branch = parent_branch
    parent_branch = tree_df$parent[tree_df$node == current_branch]
    burden_adj = 0
  }
  # If not one single branch on the whole climb found an anchor
  if (!any_assigned && total_adj > 0) { total_sbs1 = NA; total_sbs5 = NA }
  list(adj = total_adj, sbs1 = total_sbs1, sbs5 = total_sbs5, unassigned = unassigned)
}

# This polyp has no APC driver, but looks like clonal expansion, so we estimate the onset of this unknown putative driver instead
APC_OVERRIDE_GROUP  = "PD40734P_PLP_03"
APC_OVERRIDE_CRYPTS = c("PD40734p_lo0006", "PD40734p_lo0007", "PD40734p_lo0009", "PD40734p_lo0011")

rows_out = list()
total_unassigned = 0  # aggregate burden with no fit anchor anywhere on its path (reported at the end, same convention as add_expsoure.R)
for (patient in PATIENTS) {
  tree = read.tree(file.path(ROOT, "LCMB_analysis/FAP/snp", patient, paste0(patient, "_snp_tree_with_branch_length.tree")))
  tree_df = read.table(file.path(ROOT, "LCMB_analysis/FAP/snp/table", paste0(patient, "_snp_tree_adjusted.txt")), sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
  true_root = tree_df$node[tree_df$parent == tree_df$node]
  pat_drivers = drivers[drivers$Patient == patient, ]

  pat_db = database[database$patient == patient, ]
  pat_db$coarse = sapply(pat_db$type, coarse_type)
  eligible = pat_db[!is.na(pat_db$coarse) & pat_db$sample %in% tree$tip.label, ]

  eligible$lesion_id = ifelse(is.na(eligible$subgroup_id) |
                                trimws(as.character(eligible$subgroup_id)) == "",
                              as.character(eligible$group_id),
                              as.character(eligible$subgroup_id))
  for (grp in unique(eligible$lesion_id)) {
    members = eligible[eligible$lesion_id == grp, ]
    if (nrow(members) < 2) next  # need >=2 crypts to define a trunk distinct from the crypt's own full root-to-tip path
    tips_in_grp = members$sample

    # Partition the group's crypts into distinct APC-driver lineages 
    lineages = list()
    assigned = character(0)
    for (crypt in tips_in_grp) {
      if (crypt %in% assigned) next
      # APC-lineage = crypts in this group with an identical, non-blank somatic1
      crypt_som1 = database[crypt, "somatic1"]
      if (is.na(crypt_som1) || crypt_som1 == "") {
        if (grp == APC_OVERRIDE_GROUP) {
          apc_lineage = intersect(APC_OVERRIDE_CRYPTS, tips_in_grp)
        } else {
          next  # no somatic APC driver for this crypt -- nothing to find
        }
      } else {
        apc_lineage = tips_in_grp[sapply(tips_in_grp, function(s) {
          s_som1 = database[s, "somatic1"]
          !is.na(s_som1) && s_som1 == crypt_som1
        })]
      }
      if (length(apc_lineage) < 2) next
      lineages[[length(lineages) + 1]] = apc_lineage
      assigned = union(assigned, apc_lineage)
    }

    for (apc_lineage in lineages) {
      trunk_res = lineage_trunk(apc_lineage, tree)
      if (is.null(trunk_res)) next
      node = trunk_res$node

      # Trunk allocation
      trunk_sums = climb_and_allocate(node, true_root, tree_df, patient)
      burden = trunk_sums$adj
      SBS1_trunk = trunk_sums$sbs1
      SBS5_trunk = trunk_sums$sbs5
      total_unassigned = total_unassigned + trunk_sums$unassigned

      # trunk_somatic_driver: count of confirmed driver events
      trunk_somatic_driver = 0
      if (nrow(pat_drivers) > 0) {
        for (k in seq_len(nrow(pat_drivers))) {
          samp_list = strsplit(pat_drivers$Sample[k], ";")[[1]]
          if (all(trunk_res$clade %in% samp_list)) trunk_somatic_driver = trunk_somatic_driver + 1
        }
      }
      # somatic_drivers.csv is a table of coordinates, so a chromosome 5 LOH or
      # CNNLOH is absent from it entirely. Count it from fap_database instead
      clade_loh = sapply(trunk_res$clade, function(s)
        any(grepl("^Chr5", c(database[s, "somatic1"], database[s, "somatic2"]))))
      if (length(clade_loh) > 0 && all(clade_loh)) {
        trunk_somatic_driver = trunk_somatic_driver + 1
      }

      for (crypt in apc_lineage) {
        tip_node = which(tree$tip.label == crypt)
        # Branch allocation
        branch_sums = climb_and_allocate(tip_node, node, tree_df, patient)
        total_unassigned = total_unassigned + branch_sums$unassigned

        rows_out[[length(rows_out) + 1]] = data.frame(
          patient = patient,
          age = database[crypt, "age"],
          trunk = paste0(patient, "_", node),
          type = members$coarse[members$sample == crypt],
          lineage = grp,
          crypt = crypt,
          trunk_somatic_driver = trunk_somatic_driver,
          SBS_total_trunk = burden,
          SBS5_trunk = SBS5_trunk,
          SBS1_trunk = SBS1_trunk,
          SBS_total_branch = branch_sums$adj,
          SBS5_branch = branch_sums$sbs5,
          SBS1_branch = branch_sums$sbs1,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
df_trunk_length = do.call(rbind, rows_out)
write.csv(df_trunk_length, file.path(ROOT, "github_repo/data/phylogenetic_tree/APC_onset_and_trunk_length.csv"), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Total unassigned burden (no fit anchor found anywhere on path; folded into SBS_total_trunk/branch but not SBS1/SBS5):", total_unassigned, "\n")
cat("Rows with fully unknown signature composition (NA):", sum(is.na(df_trunk_length$SBS1_trunk) | is.na(df_trunk_length$SBS1_branch)), "/", nrow(df_trunk_length), "\n")

df_trunk_length$trunk_driver_1 = T
df_trunk_length$trunk_driver_1[df_trunk_length$trunk_somatic_driver>1] = F
df_trunk_length = df_trunk_length[df_trunk_length$type!='polyp' | df_trunk_length$trunk_somatic_driver>1,]
lmm <- lme(SBS_total_branch ~ type, random = ~1|patient/lineage, data = df_trunk_length, method = "ML")
summary(lmm)



df_trunk=df_trunk_length[,c(1:5,7:10)]
df_trunk=unique(df_trunk)
lmm <- lme(SBS_total_trunk ~ type, random = ~1|patient, data = df_trunk, method = "ML")
summary(lmm)
```
